If we have Martyred Intellectuals Day, why isn't there a Martyred Workers Day?
2024-12-17T21:59:48+06:00 | Star Special
https://www.thedailystar.net/star-multimedia/views-multimedia/news/if-we-have-martyred-intellectuals-day-why-isnt-there-martyred-workers-day-3778701

On December 14, in observance of Martyred Intellectuals Day, The Daily Star held a discussion titled "The Role of Intellectuals in State Reform".

In today's episode of Star Special, Professor Dr Salimullah Khan holds an in-depth conversation with The Daily Star Editor Mahfuz Anam.
